name: Group Surf Lesson
operator_name: The Perfect Wave Cokes Surf Camp
notes: Source: perfectwavetravel.com/nz/surf-trips/maldives/cokes-surf-camp (Perfect Wave Travel's own page for Cokes Surf Camp), corroborated by cokessurfcampmaldives.com. Distinct from the existing 'Private Surf Lesson (Cokes)' entry (same operator, $75/hr private): this is the camp's group-coaching product, described as two ISA-qualified instructors each taking groups of up to 4 students for 2-hour sessions, all equipment provided. cokessurfcampmaldives.com states lessons run daily at Chickens, Baby Chickens, Ninjas, Sultans or Honkeys depending on conditions and group level; 'Baby Chickens' was not added as its own surf_breaks.json entry (too thinly documented on its own) so only the four names matching confirmed break entries were kept in surf_break_names. No distinct group price surfaced separately from the private-lesson rate card, so price_from was left null rather than assumed equal to the private rate.

name: Guided Surf Boat Trip
notes: Source: twinpalmssurfhouse.com (operator's own 'Activities' and 'The Surfhouse' pages), corroborated by stokedsurfadventures.com's 'Twin Palms Beach House' tour listing. Twin Palms Surfhouse is a real, independently-run guesthouse on Thulusdhoo (distinct from the existing 'The Perfect Wave Cokes Surf Camp' operator). Its own site describes 3-hour boat trips to 'some of the world-class surf spots around Thulusdhoo' guided by a local captain, who picks the day's spot based on conditions -- no single break was named for this specific product, so surf_break_names was left empty per the task rule (only populate when a source explicitly names a break for this product). The site also separately mentions 'personalised classes with experienced instructors' for varying skill levels, but no distinct lesson product/price could be confidently separated from the boat-trip product, so only the boat trip was recorded as its own entry. Price and max group size were not found in the snippets reviewed; left null.

name: Surf Lesson
notes: Source: search-result pricing summaries citing Amphibuzz's own listings (amaldives.com/operators/amphibuzz-watersports-excursions; seasonparadise.mv/surfing/), corroborated by surfcamp-online.com's 'Season Paradise Surf Camp' listing. Amphibuzz is the watersports/surf-school brand operating on-site at Season Paradise hotel, Thulusdhoo -- kept as a distinct operator_name from 'Season Paradise' itself, matching the pattern already used for resort dive centres in data/maldives/diving (e.g. 'Divers Baros Maldives' distinct from Baros the resort). The $75 lesson price is explicitly hedged in the source summary as 'surf lessons can cost about $75' -- an approximate figure, not a firm quoted rate, so treat with reduced confidence. Sources gave conflicting audience framing (one page: 'arranged for beginners and children'; Season Paradise's own page: 'perfect for beginners and seasoned surfers alike') -- difficulty left null rather than picking one. Duration not found; left null.

name: Surfboard Rental
notes: Source: same query batch/summary as the Amphibuzz 'Surf Lesson' entry above ('you can rent a surf board for about $35'). Same operator (Amphibuzz at Season Paradise, Thulusdhoo). The $35 figure is explicitly hedged as an approximate ('about $35') in the source summary, so treat as lower-confidence. No rental period (per hour/day) was specified in the snippets reviewed, so duration_minutes was left null rather than guessed.

name: Wave Surfing
notes: Source: maafushidive.com/products/wave-surfing (operator's own product page). Existing operator (already in the dataset for diving products) confirmed to also run a real surf product: a 60-minute wave-surfing session at Guraidhoo Corner, a 10-15 minute boat ride from Maafushi, max 4 people, boards provided, extra hours billed at $20/hour waiting charge. The page states surf lessons are 'available for beginners in a safe and controlled environment under professional instructors,' which reads like coaching rather than a pure guided outing, so classified as surf_lesson rather than guided_surfing; flagged here since the line between the two is not sharp for this product. The base session price itself did not surface in the snippets reviewed (only the $20/hr extra-hour waiting charge did), so price_from was left null rather than using that surcharge figure.

name: Wave Surfing
notes: Source: activemaldives.com/wave-surfing (operator's own product page), corroborated by followmetomaldives.com's 'Wave Surfing Adventure in Maafushi' writeup. Existing operator (already in the dataset for diving/fishing products) confirmed to run a distinct, separately-branded surf product from Maafushi Dive and Water Sports' own 'Wave Surfing' above -- both are real, independent operators running trips to the same break (Guraidhoo Corner), so both were kept as separate entries. This product is explicitly described for 'whether you're a beginner or experienced' surfer (difficulty recorded as all_levels), with on-beach instruction for beginners before entering the water, boards included for the first 60 minutes, and a guide plus boat transport for a group of up to 20. A $35/$60 figure found in the same search batch was explicitly for jet-ski rental, not wave surfing, so it was NOT used here; price_from left null since no wave-surfing-specific figure surfaced.

name: Multi-Day Surf Camp Package
notes: Source: booking.com and tripadvisor.com listings for 'Jail Break Surf Inn' (Himmafushi Island), corroborated by jailbreaksurfinn.com and perfectwavetravel.com's 'Jailbreak Surf Inn' page. A real, named surf guesthouse directly on Himmafushi, at the Jailbreak surf break. Package tiers found in booking listings: a bed & breakfast tier with '1 boat trip per day to Jails/Honkys/Sultans', and a full-board tier with 'up to 2 boat trips per day' -- these three break names were used for surf_break_names since they are explicitly named by the source. This is a bundled accommodation + surf-transfer package rather than a single-session product (matching the task's own 'Surf Camp package' example), so no single duration applies; duration_minutes and price_from were both left null since no per-package USD figure surfaced in the snippets reviewed (only room-night-style listings, which were not confidently separable into a single 'activity' price).

name: Beginner Lagoon Surf Lesson
notes: Source: sixsenses.com/en/experiences/soul-surfing and sixsenses.com's Laamu 'Surfing with Tropicsurf' experience page, corroborated by curatedtravelmagazine.substack.com's 'Six Senses Laamu Launches Learn to Surf Experience' and theartsshelf.com. Reuses the existing 'Six Senses' operator (already in providers.json for Six Senses Laamu accommodation); this is Six Senses Laamu's in-house surf program, run in partnership with Tropicsurf, at the resort island Olhuveli (Six Senses Laamu). 'Beginner Lagoon Lessons start from US$95++ per hour' in the calm lagoon in front of the resort's Surf Shack -- the '++' denotes service charge/tax not included in the quoted figure, noted here since price_from ($95) reflects the base rate only. Explicitly a beginner-oriented product (lagoon lessons for first-timers), so difficulty recorded as beginner. Not tied to a named surf break (lessons happen in the resort lagoon, not at Yin-Yang or another named break), so surf_break_names is empty.

name: First Green Wave Private Surf Lesson
notes: Source: same query/summary batch as the 'Beginner Lagoon Surf Lesson' entry above (sixsenses.com Soul Surfing / Surfing with Tropicsurf pages). 'Catching your first green wave with a private Tropicsurf guide costs US$145++ for 1.5 hours' -- recorded as a distinct, more advanced-beginner product from the base lagoon lesson (private guide, aimed at riding an actual unbroken/'green' wave rather than whitewash). Again, '++' means the $145 base figure excludes service charge/tax. Kept as beginner difficulty since the milestone described ('first green wave') is explicitly a beginner progression step, not an intermediate/advanced product.
